title: Trigon Dataset Candidate Registry
description: Public metadata for datasets and analysis bundles queued for possible Trigon Challenges. Inclusion means candidate status only, not validation or support for UBT.
stable_id_rule: Assign the next unused TRIGON-DATA-NNNN identifier once. Never recycle IDs. Mark duplicates with duplicate_of instead of deleting history.
release_rule: Only metadata safe for public release may appear here. Raw restricted/private files, secrets, personal data, and uncleared mirrored copies remain outside the public registry.

readiness_definitions.READY: Publicly accessible candidate with enough provenance, rights information, preprocessing detail, controls, nulls, metrics, and failure criteria to begin a reproducible Trigon run.
readiness_definitions.NEEDS_PREP: Promising public candidate that still needs preparation, rights clarification, variable mapping, preprocessing, controls, or a stronger test card.
readiness_definitions.BLOCKED: Cannot currently be used because of access, licensing, provenance, privacy, technical, or scientific blockers.
readiness_definitions.DUPLICATE: Same underlying dataset or materially identical candidate already represented by another stable candidate ID.
readiness_definitions.ARCHIVED: Retained for provenance/history but no longer an active Trigon candidate.
